chunks: 66 – Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Quḍāʿa b. Ṣafwān b. Mihrān, Abū ʿAbdillāh, al-Ṣafwāni.

I have not disclaimed anything from him except for what he narrates [from his father] from his grandfather, from al-Ṣādiq (peace be upon him), for it is something unknown, and I have seen in it unrecognized (matters) untrue against/upon him. And I suspect that the lying was by his father.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: al-Ṣādiq (the Truthful), referring to Imam Ja'far al-Ṣādiq (AS)
key_terms.مَنَاكِرَ: unrecognized or singular narrations (ahād) that contradict established reports

ai.seo_question: What is the reliability status of Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Ṣafwāni in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical entry from Kitāb al-Duʿafāʾ evaluates the narrator Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Ṣafwāni. The author notes that he is generally reliable, except for narrations from his father and grandfather to al-Ṣādiq, which are considered unknown and contain fabricated elements likely originating from his father.
